description: Get the live premarket scanner board (premarket small-cap runners): top premarket gainers and losers by absolute gap %, each row enriched with rvol, marketCap, floatShares, short interest, dilution and news/catalyst flags. Off-hours it falls back to the last session. includePennyStocks=true includes sub-$1 names. Float: floatShares is the measured point float (null on a withheld dilution-snapshot row, which then carries "floatEstimate" {shares, bound: "point" | "ceiling" | "floor", basis}). A point estimate is a number with its as-of and caveat; a ceiling or floor is a bound, not a figure: the float is not stated and is at most (ceiling) or at least (floor) that number, and is not a basis for arithmetic; neither present = not measured, not 0. The low-float board admits on that figure's value (an 8M ceiling is in, a 26M floor is out). Compliance: row "compliance", the compliance/split badges, "reverseSplitSignal" and "deficiencySignal" are Signal8 Pro; for other callers "compliance" is null with "complianceWithheld": "pro_required", meaning withheld, which is not "not measured" and not "no deficiency". Live volume (04:00-09:30 ET only; null outside the window or until the baseline is warm, never fabricated) has two different metrics, neither interchangeable with the other or with "rvol". "liveRvol" = live cumulative premarket volume / the trailing 30-session average cumulative volume at the same time of morning, with "liveRvolAsOf" the 15-minute grid cutoff (meta.asOf shows any time skew); "premarketPaceRatio" = the same volume / the trailing 30-session average full premarket session (>1.0 = already beat a normal premarket). universe="lowfloat" returns the separate low-float board (float under 10M, no top-100 slice) from the aggregator snapshot; an empty rows array with meta.reason when none is published is a normal off-hours state.

includePennyStocks.description: Include sub-$1 (penny) stocks in the results. Default false.

sort.description: Sort key for the low-float board: "gap" (default) or "rvol". Ignored for universe="default", which is always gap-ranked.

universe.description: Which board to return. "default" (the default) is the movers-derived top-100 board. "lowfloat" is the low-float board (float < 10M shares, no top-100 slice).
